How to prepare

  • Your latest school documents or grades (certificate, transcript, GPA)
  • Any language test results (IELTS, TOEFL, Duolingo, SAT…)
  • Countries and majors you are interested in (it is fine if you are not sure yet)
  • A rough yearly budget: tuition + living costs
  • If a parent wants to join, join together
